title: Factorization criterion for henselian pairs
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal. Assume $I$ is contained in the Jacobson radical of $A$. Then $(A,I)$ is henselian [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] if and only if every factorization $\overline f=g_0h_0$ of the reduction of a monic polynomial $f\in A[T]$ into monic polynomials in $(A/I)[T]$ whose generated ideals are the unit ideal lifts to a factorization $f=gh$ by monic polynomials $g,h\in A[T]$ reducing to $g_0,h_0$ modulo $I$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 09XI (lemma-characterize-henselian-pair), equivalence (1) <=> (5), and Definition Tag 09XE
